cohort: 989 obstetric patients (956 pregnant and 33 postpartum) with laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 admitted to 53 hospitals in India
finding: This observational study of 989 obstetric patients in India with COVID-19 found that 83.41% were asymptomatic, 59.01% underwent caesarean section, and the rates of maternal and neonatal mortality were higher than in pregnant women without COVID-19.
mod_finding: COVID-19 infection in obstetric cases from India led to 59.01% LSCS procedures which are lower than many other countries.
gest_age: Data available for 966 women, of whom 492 (52.73%) had a gestational age >37 weeks.
